platform: real AAOS 15 / Anbox Cloud / NVIDIA L4
inputPolicy: Controlled camera/audio must cross the actual Android media pipeline. No score, landmark, gate, ASR-result, or provider-response replacement.

common.coverage: Discover enabled and disabled controls in every result tab, carousel slide, modal and saved result; record expected and actual state, timestamp, and screenshot. No unseen control counts as PASS.

vision.input: Three approved full-geometry camera views and synthetic spoken responses through Android microphone
vision.processing: Original MediaPipe face/eye gate and optotype scoring; explicitly opted-in real OpenAI transcription of Android-captured PCM/WebM, with a separate cloud-audio consent

skin.input: Approved FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT camera fixtures; original capture and quality gates
skin.processing: Three actual /api/local-health/skin POSTs; verified experimental acne-v5 model and current production models
results: previous/next finding and overview page controls
skin.limitation: Experimental acne-v5 inference is not production clinical validation

dental.input: Approved project dental media; FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/BITE through camera
dental.processing: Actual dental preprocessing/ONNX inference; original four-view validation

hearing.input: Original stereo check and generated DIN audio; controlled responses entered through actual UI
hearing.processing: Unmodified randomization, audio timing, 24-trial staircase and scoring
hearing.limitation: Controlled engineering test; no calibrated human headset or clinical hearing acceptance

mental.input: Synthetic non-personal multi-turn speech; actual Android microphone and ASR
mental.processing: Current structured-v1 conversation engine and approved recorded voice assets; real OpenAI audio transcription and session analysis; original session context; actual dynamically generated Chatterbox summary and full closing playback
